additionalProperties.description: A gate, by its name: the one a gate.open step, an intent's record.missing or a verb's gate opens; a gate the loop opens by kind takes the first of its kind. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.
An intent, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

answer.description: The intent takes text, such as a question's answer.

label.description: The name people read on its button.

status.description: The status the intent resolves the gate to; required for a new intent.

intents.description: What you may resolve the gate with, by intent, in the order clients offer them.

kind.description: What the gate decides, which names the consequence of resolving it; required for a new gate.

label.description: What the gate asks of you, as clients list it.

gates.description: The gates a profile names, by name, in the order the file declares them, a user layer's new ones after the bundled.
